_comment: DA-004 token-drift baseline. Each entry is a desktop token whose value currently diverges from design/tokens.css (the canonical source of truth extracted from darknode-web). These are pre-existing forks of the design system; the drift guard (test/design/tokens-drift.test.mjs) FAILS if a NEW divergence appears or if an entry here no longer diverges (remove it then). Goal: shrink to empty as the desktop is unified to canonical in a session that can render and visually diff. Values changed here alter the desktop's appearance, so unification is deferred until it can be visually verified.
reason: Desktop shipped a forked design system before DA-004; unified to canonical on 2026-10-10 (renderer/styles.css now holds the canonical values for every shared token). Baseline is empty — the app no longer forks the design system.

nameDivergences._comment: Desktop token NAMES absent from canonical (parallel system). --bg-2 duplicates canonical --bg2 under a different name; the rest are desktop-only surfaces that should be re-expressed on canonical tokens. Informational; not asserted by the guard.
